mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) indicate strengthening residential construction demand, which typically precedes increased consumer spending and corporate investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds its 10-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 4.5% signals restrictive monetary policy, reducing corporate borrowing capacity and compressing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and rise in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening labor market and manufacturing sector, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of UNRATE decline and INDPRO rise fails to produce positive 60-day returns in at least 60% of cases, or interaction term p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% year-over-year) typically prompts restrictive monetary policy, compressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during high-inflation regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Steady growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds its 12-month average.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 900,000 units signal weakening residential demand, typically preceding reduced consumer confidence and lower corporate capital expenditures, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 900.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and drop in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates broad economic slowdown, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in GDPC1 and INDPRO fails to produce negative 60-day returns in at least 60% of cases, or interaction term p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 0.3pp increase over 3 months) signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during labor market stress regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months.
